reigns.note: Son of Cretheus, who founded Pherae in Thessaly and begat Admetus and Lycurgus.
King when Apollo served him as thrall, when he won Alcestis, and when Heracles wrestled Death for her return.
Son of Admetus and Alcestis, who led the Pheraean ships to Troy and raced at the funeral games on the plain.
